evidence.title: Cursor traces extension compromise through historical coding-agent records
evidence.observation: Cursor reports that access originating from a vendor-issued key exposed historical agent traces containing credentials. It links those retained credentials to downstream access used to distribute an unauthorized extension.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded observation; not independently verified by Commons
evidence.glossary_fit: Commons interpretation only; founding definitions and standings unchanged

source_locations.SRC-164: Investigation update; root cause and credential chain

evidence.limitations: The causal account is Cursor’s reconstruction. The Commons did not independently inspect the underlying logs or retrieve the specific Fireworks bulletin. No autonomous attacker behavior is established.
evidence.open_questions: Which historical artifacts carry authority into systems outside their original workflow?
evidence.support_assessment: Commons interpretation: Information retained for one purpose can later enable consequential access in a different environment.
evidence.dispute_status: Source access, scope and generalization qualifications retained; no systematic clearance.
